    def __init__(self, capacity, refill_per_sec, queue_max=50):
        self.capacity = capacity
        self.tokens = capacity
        self.refill = refill_per_sec
        self.queue_max = queue_max
        self.waiting = 0
        self.last = time.monotonic()

    def try_acquire(self, cost=1):
